reasoning: As of October 16, 2025, there are only 15 days until the October 31 deadline. Tesla has been developing FSD for years but has not yet released a truly unsupervised version meeting all criteria (no driver required, public roads, broadly accessible). While Tesla has made progress with FSD beta versions, these still require driver monitoring. The criteria require complete removal of human oversight/intervention requirement and broad public accessibility. Given the tight timeline, regulatory hurdles, and Tesla's historical delays on autonomous driving promises, a full launch meeting all specifications in 15 days is highly unlikely.
